title.zh: 阿酥在coding（LofiSu）：当"身份工程"遇上评分引擎
title.en: LofiSu: when identity engineering meets a scoring engine

intro.zh: 2026 年 5 月，围绕这位 00 后开发者的争议刷屏中文技术圈：Apache Committer 身份是真的，DeerFlow 参与也是真的，但"20 岁 AI 天才"的叙事撑得住吗？ghfind 引擎只读 GitHub 公开数据，给出的评分是 49.9。这一期不是推荐，是一份档案——以及一个行业问题：当包装比实干便宜，数据核查该如何定价。
intro.en: In May 2026 the Chinese dev community erupted over this Gen-Z developer: the Apache committer status is real, the DeerFlow participation is real — but does the "20-year-old AI prodigy" narrative hold? Reading nothing but public GitHub data, the ghfind engine scores the account 49.9. This issue is not a recommendation but a case file — and an industry question: when packaging is cheaper than substance, what prices in the fact-check?

headline.zh: Apache Fory Committer · DeerFlow 贡献者 · ghfind 评分 49.9（NPC）
headline.en: Apache Fory committer · DeerFlow contributor · ghfind score 49.9 (NPC)

blurb.zh: 争议的中心仓库：字节跳动开源的长时程 SuperAgent 框架。ghfind 图谱里它有 26 位已评分贡献者，平均 77.1 分；LofiSu 在其中的贡献记录为 15 commits / 1 PR。
blurb.en: The repo at the center of the dispute: ByteDance's open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness. In the ghfind graph it counts 26 scored contributors averaging 77.1; LofiSu's recorded contribution is 15 commits / 1 PR.

stats.description: An open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness that researches, codes, and creates
